name: Sarawak Energy Marathon 2027
short_description: The Sarawak Energy Marathon returns to Kuching on Sunday 8 August 2027, with distances from 5 km up to the full marathon.
ai_summary: The Sarawak Energy Marathon is scheduled for Sunday 8 August 2027 in Kuching, Sarawak. It is organised by Sarawak Energy Berhad, the state power utility, and is AIMS-sanctioned. The full marathon is the headline distance, with half marathon, 10 km and 5 km races alongside it. Distances shown are those of the most recent edition; the 2027 line-up has not been published yet. The 2026 edition started from Menara Sarawak Energy.

faqs.question: When is the Sarawak Energy Marathon 2027?
faqs.answer: Sunday 8 August 2027, in Kuching, Sarawak. The race is organised by Sarawak Energy Berhad, the state electricity utility, and is one of two AIMS-sanctioned marathons held in Kuching, alongside the Kuching Marathon in September.

faqs.question: What distances does the Sarawak Energy Marathon offer?
faqs.answer: The full 42.195 km marathon is the headline event, with a half marathon, a 10 km and a 5 km run alongside it. These are the distances from the most recent edition; the 2027 categories and entry fees have not been published yet.
